summary.pre_registered_rule: Verifier marks each row TRUE / PARTLY / FALSE / NOT-CHECKABLE against the OSS repo at the HEAD commit on the day of checking (record the SHA). Hit rate = (TRUE + 0.5 PARTLY) / (TRUE + PARTLY + FALSE) over rows with checkable_in_oss=true and contamination in {none, possible}; report the 'none'-only rate separately. Brier score over the same rows using 'confidence'.

models.py AgentModel.tasks -> Task{tools_config, toolchain{execution parallel|sequential, pipelines}, task_type, task_config}; ToolsConfig has llm_agent, synthesizer, transcriber, input, output, api_tools; TaskManager._get_next_step walks the pipeline

local_setup/quickstart_server.py websocket /chat/v1/{agent_id} -> AssistantManager -> TaskManager.run() gathers _listen_transcriber, transcriber.run, __listen_synthesizer, __process_output_loop, __check_for_completion as asyncio tasks joined by queues

local_setup/telephony_server/plivo_api_server.py places the call via the Plivo REST client and answers with <Stream bidirectional> XML pointing at the ws server; twilio_api_server.py does the same with TwiML
no batch, schedule, calling-guardrail, RabbitMQ or arq code anywhere in bolna/ (grep); the checkable half (layer absent from OSS) holds; the RabbitMQ/Redis detail is not checkable

litellm==1.84.0 is a dependency and providers.py routes cohere/ollama/deepinfra/together/fireworks/perplexity/vllm/anyscale/groq/anthropic/deepseek/openrouter through LiteLLM, but openai, azure/azure-openai and google use native SDK classes (OpenAiLLM, AzureLLM, GeminiLLM); custom = OpenAI-compatible base_url is true
one class per provider behind BaseTranscriber/BaseSynthesizer; all six named classes present plus google, gladia, pixa, gemini, realtime ('bolna')

input/output handlers exist for twilio, exotel, plivo, vobiz, sip-trunk (Asterisk chan_websocket, ulaw) and freeswitch (L16 16k in, 24k web TTS); 'trunk' is an enum label riding the freeswitch fork; 'default' is the plain ws handler. The hedge that vobiz/trunk/freeswitch may be closed was unnecessary

no turn-detector model; end of turn = Deepgram speech_final/UtteranceEnd (endpointing, utterance_end_ms), Flux EndOfTurn/EagerEndOfTurn, AssemblyAI/Soniox native; then InterruptionManager holds audio until incremental_delay (default 900 ms) has passed since the final

InterruptionManager.should_trigger_interruption: interim word_count > number_of_words_for_interruption (default 1, so 2 words) or exact whole-transcript match in ACCIDENTAL_INTERRUPTION_PHRASES; Deepgram speech_started only sets flags, never interrupts
no silero/webrtcvad/torch dependency; VAD comes from the STT provider (vad_events, high_vad_sensitivity) or S2S provider

hangup_after_LLMCall -> agent.check_for_completion() with CHECK_FOR_COMPLETION_PROMPT 'You are an AI assistant determining if a conversation is complete' after each turn; end_call tool is an alternative mode
